scripts.bootstrap: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev:windows: start "NFTSol Server" cmd /k "npm run dev:server" && timeout /t 2 && start "NFTSol Client" cmd /k "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:simple: start "Server" cmd /k "npm run dev --prefix server" && start "Client" cmd /k "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
